name: Jarad
description: The Golgari guildmaster Vraska killed to take his place.

timeline.summary: Savra's death and Jarad's succession end the Golgari attack and force a withdrawal.
timeline.quote: Only the death of Savra and the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo , ultimately brought the Golgari attack to an end

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Dissension, Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother Jarad, who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda sacrifices Jarad in a ritual to arouse Rakdos, but he survives by becoming a zombie/lich and keeps leadership.
timeline.quote: He was later sacrificed by Izolda ( Lyzolda, the Blood Witch ) as part of a ritual to arouse Rakdos , the parun of the Cult of Rakdos .

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack Szadek, defeating him.
timeline.quote: He is ultimately defeated when Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack him.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Rakdos awakened and wreaked havoc in the streets of Ravnica until the demon crossed the path of Project Kraj .

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad seizes Savra's staff and turns Szadek's Lupul against him.
timeline.quote: Jarad vod Savo , Savra’s brother, seized Savra’s staff

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aftermath: Jarad becomes Golgari guildmaster, Kos prepares to leave the force, and Luda's body is revealed to be a Lupul.
timeline.quote: Jarad rising as the new Golgari guildmaster

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad declines Dr. Otrovac's offer of cytoplast enhancements, suspecting a trick.
timeline.quote: Jarad fails to see the benefit for the Simic, and declines the offer, thinking something fishy is behind it.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 5". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lyzolda uses Myc's blood to raise Rakdos but Jarad's intervention disrupts the ritual and links Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: The demon is awakened but the intervention of Jarad disrupts the ritual and gives Myc a mind link with the demon god instead.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 11". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lyzolda kills Jarad and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Jarad catches up with Lyzolda, who kills him and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fonn brings Myc to Jarad, now a zombie; Myc decides to become a Golgari hunter.
timeline.quote: Fonn brings her son to his father, who used necromancy to become a zombie.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda raises Rakdos from his pit with Myc Zunich's blood; Myc briefly controls him before Izolda takes control.
timeline.quote: Izolda was able to finish the ritual and took control over Rakdos herself.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
timeline.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather becomes Boros guildleader, Leonos II takes over the Azorius, Jarad returns as a lich, and the Simic remain leaderless.
timeline.quote: Feather became the new guildleader of the Boros, Leonos II took the reigns of the Azorius

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad saves Fonn from Savra's assassination plot against Bayul.
timeline.quote: Fonn was saved by the bounty hunter Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek is defeated thanks to Jarad and Mat'Selesnya reinvigorated by Biracazir's lifeforce.
timeline.quote: Szadek was defeated thanks to Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fonn and Jarad marry and have a son.
timeline.quote: The pair married, and stayed together for some time

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists waylay Fonn's training group; Jarad and Fonn accidentally bind Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: accidentally binding Myc's mind with the demon 's.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad sacrifices his life to free Myc.
timeline.quote: Jarad sacrificed his life to free Myc.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad maintains his power, ruthlessly quelling dissent from the Teratogens.
timeline.quote: Jarad maintained his power, quelling without mercy any rumblings of mutiny or dissent from the Teratogens.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Return to Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad Vod Savo rises as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Jarad learned the ways of necromancy and was able to rise as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2", section "Jarad Vod Savo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad survives several assassination attempts by feeding off his challengers' power.
timeline.quote: He has survived several assassination attempts from various upstarts, using the power of necromancy to feed off the power of his challengers.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2", section "Jarad Vod Savo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad holds his position by reclaiming derelict districts, expecting the Devkarin and Lotleth to eventually dethrone him.
timeline.quote: He knows the power-hungry Devkarin elves and the decomposing Lotleth undead will eventually dethrone him

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2", section "The Street Swarm, shepherds of the cycle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The lupuls, thought defeated centuries earlier, resurface under Szadek until Jarad disrupts his control.
timeline.quote: they resurfaced under Szadek 's command, until his control was disrupted by Jarad .

citation.text: "Shapeshifter", section "Lupuls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sobeslav, Jarad's assistant, reads letters in the Guildhall and finds one from Mazirek of the kraul inviting Jarad.
timeline.quote: From Mazirek of the kraul.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
timeline.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
timeline.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska prepares to petrify Jarad.
timeline.quote: and contemplated what she ought to say to Jarad before she petrified him.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas rewards Vraska with the location where Jarad is imprisoned after the Immortal Sun affair on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Pleased with the planewalker Vraska 's role in securing the Immortal Sun in Ixalan , Nicol Bolas rewarded her with the information where Jarad was imprisoned.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska frees Jarad and becomes the new Golgari leader herself.
timeline.quote: She took Jarad out and became the new leader herself.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Jarad and establishes herself as Golgari guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Vraska killed Jarad and established herself as guildmaster

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad is mocked as king of rot.
timeline.quote: Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot.

citation.text: Necropolis Regent (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Kos's first case Zunich mistakenly kills a little girl used as bait for Palla.
timeline.quote: Zunich was too eager to get the cultist and mistakenly attacked and killed a little girl

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zunich tries to kill Jarad as the sole witness; Kos intervenes and Zunich falls to his death.
timeline.quote: Zunich slipped off the roof and was killed on impact

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
timeline.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The goblin assassin detonates a bomb at Aul House, killing himself, Bayul and Borca; Kos survives and Fonn is removed to the Undercity by Jarad vod Savo.
timeline.quote: The goblin assassin then detonated a bomb, killing himself, Bayul, and Borca in the blast.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda tries to raise and control Rakdos using draconic cerebral fluid from Momir Vig and Myc's blood; Myc's parents unintentionally disrupt the spell, joining Myc's and Rakdos's minds.
timeline.quote: resulted in a shared mind between Myc and Rakdos instead

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda finishes the ritual by killing Jarad and taking control of Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Izolda finished the ritual by killing Jarad and taking control of Rakdos herself.

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Opposed to his twin Savra, Jarad allies with Agrus Kos and Fonn Zunich and upsets Szadek's coup at the Decamillennial Festival; after Savra dies he takes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: he took control of the Golgari Swarm

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Bounty hunter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad briefly marries Fonn and fathers Myc; they separate.
timeline.quote: He briefly married Fonn and fathered a child named Myc

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Guild leader". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Izolda kills Jarad in a Rakdos ritual as he tries to rescue Myc; he possesses his own corpse and becomes a lich.
timeline.quote: he managed to possess his corpse

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Lich". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cilia isolate Jarad; Nicol Bolas tells Vraska where he is.
timeline.quote: the Cilia isolated Jarad in a sparsely populated corner of the Undercity

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Final death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Jarad; Storrev betrays him, Xeddick extracts his secrets, and Vraska petrifies him.
timeline.quote: Vraska petrified him

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Final death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists capture Myc and Izolda attempts the domination ritual; Jarad's arrow spills the blood mixture over Rakdos and Myc, binding their minds.
timeline.quote: binding Myc's mind with Rakdos'

citation.text: "Myczil Savod Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarad's sacrifice to Izolda breaks the bond, and Fonn rescues Myc; Jarad becomes a kind of lich and Myc chooses the Golgari.

citation.text: "Myczil Savod Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Savra gives Jarad a mission and speaks with Szadek about finding Svogthir and overthrowing the Gorgon leadership.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
